rows.title: Single N64 and GameCube games
rows.tested: Month ends, Oct 2022 to Sep 2026, loose and boxed copies of the basket's 136 games. Move over the next 1, 3 and 6 months.
rows.verdict: The clearest pattern found, and it held on the bigger set of 136 games: games far under their usual price rose about seven times in ten over the next one, three and six months, and stretched ones fell about two times in three. On PriceCharting's full history back to 2007 it held in every five-year stretch.
